name: typeorm
description: TypeORM with the postgres driver, through DataSource.transaction() and repositories, with EntitySchema entities. MG-02 and MG-03 call DataSource.runMigrations() and undoLastMigration(). The default transaction mode is all, and there is no advisory lock.

modes.description: TypeORM's defaults, with the managed transaction API ds.transaction(callback).

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: TypeORM has no propagation modes and no deferred writes in the repository API this adapter uses: a nested manager.transaction() is always a savepoint, and every insert is sent when it is made. An independent transaction is an unrelated ds.transaction() on another connection, which shares no pending writes with the outer one, so the hazard TX-04.3 targets (pending outer writes committed by the inner transaction) cannot arise.
